item.title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models
item.summary: arXiv:2608.21595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs), and diversifying the rollouts within each optimization group amplifies its gains. Existing approaches diversify through decoding temperature or pixel-space image distortion; we ask whether the perturbation belongs in the model's latent space instead. We introduce Noise-Contrastive GRPO (NC-GRPO), which injects scale-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the prompt-encoding pass for half of each rollout group, branching those rollouts from a displaced departure state. Branches that reach the answer despite the displacement are reinforced over those derailed by it, converting sensitivity at the branch point into policy-gradient signal; the objective, reward, and inference protocol are untouched.
